name: milestone-docs
description: Milestone validation of documentation by a hydrology reader, a modeler reader, and a document-drift check, paired into one report

branches.prompt: Moment: docs. Milestone {{milestone}}. Pages: {{pages}}. Write .kiro/workflow-output/{{milestone}}/findings-hydro.md in the findings format and end your final message with the VERDICT line.
Milestone {{milestone}}. Pages: {{pages}}. Write .kiro/workflow-output/{{milestone}}/findings-modeler.md in the findings format.

Milestone {{milestone}}. Check the four planning documents under dev/plan/ against the repository as your instructions list, including ROADMAP's done-when lines for {{milestone}}. Write .kiro/workflow-output/{{milestone}}/findings-drift.md in the findings format.

steps.prompt: Mode: report. Milestone {{milestone}}. Read .kiro/workflow-output/{{milestone}}/findings-hydro.md, findings-modeler.md, and findings-drift.md. Pair hydrology and modeler findings on the same sentence and label each pair jargon or imprecision; keep drift findings keyed by anchor. Write .kiro/workflow-output/{{milestone}}/docs-report.md with no VERDICT line.
